checks.name: COLLECTION: real cheek gesture unlocks, previews and survives reload
LINKS: unsupported rules and malformed challenges show an explanation

method: Trusted Playwright mouse pointer input. Only test=1 metric checks use __game.step; persisted, shared and collection flows use real pointer input and real elapsed time. Viewports are emulated.
limitations: Physical iPhone Safari and Android are not connected. Linux WebKit and Chromium viewport emulation are not physical-device certification. OS share-sheet UI is unavailable in headless browsers; fallback share is exercised.
